raw_segments.text: Clown, two faults, Madonna, that drink and good counsel will amend.
Forgive the dry fool drink, then is the fool not dry.
Bid the dishonest man mend himself if he mend, he is no longer dishonest.
If he cannot, let the botcher mend him.
Anything that's mended is but patched, virtue that transgresses is but patched with sin,
and sin that amends is but patched with virtue.
If that this simple syllogism will serve so, if it will not, what remedy?
As there is no true cuckold but calamity, so beauty's a flower.
The lady bade take away the fool, therefore, I say again, take her away.
